title: Using AI for UX Work: Study Guide
description: Nielsen Norman Group has curated a comprehensive study guide covering best practices for integrating AI into UX workflows. Essential resource for designers and product managers looking to upskill and apply AI effectively in their work.

title: Reading and writing are interfaces. And AI can reduce their friction.
description: This essay reframes reading and writing as core interfaces that AI can optimize, arguing that the real question isn't whether AI reduces work, but where intellectual effort shifts. A thought-provoking perspective for designers thinking about AI's role in cognitive workflows.

title: How to Audit and Extend Your Figma Design System with Claude Code
description: A practical guide showing how Claude Code's new /design plugin enables designers to audit and scale design systems efficiently. Perfect for design leaders managing consistency across large design organizations.

title: Why Brand Designers Need to Think Like Clients, Not Just Creators
description: This interview challenges designers to adopt a client-centric mindset in brand work, shifting from pure creative expression to strategic business value. Critical perspective for elevating design's role within organizations.

title: Figma Design Critique Using Claude Code
description: Explores how Claude Code's design plugin automates design critique and feedback, reducing manual review time and improving design quality at scale. Practical tool for design teams seeking workflow automation.

title: Normal Tools
description: A collection of small, focused browser-based tools designed with intentional simplicity and utility. A refreshing resource for designers seeking lightweight, distraction-free alternatives to bloated software.

title: Clockwork
source: Product Hunt — The best new products, every day
description: A calendar platform where AI agents autonomously manage scheduling and tasks, representing a new paradigm in how teams coordinate work. Significant for understanding how AI augments productivity and team collaboration.

title: GPT-6 Astra
source: Product Hunt — The best new products, every day
description: OpenAI's latest flagship model promises end-to-end work capabilities, marking a milestone in AI capability that will reshape how designers, product managers, and teams approach complex projects. Critical to understand the latest AI landscape.
